accepted_scope: prospective decision attribution and complete protected lifecycle capture only
decision: The preregistered V56 SPCX long lifecycle is technically complete and economically negative. Keep the live V56 entry, prior-close target, 80-bps stop, sizing, and holding contract unchanged. Reject the preregistered 40/60/80-bps fixed-target family because every challenger materially underperformed the prior-close control in development and retained unresolved historical entry paths. Start a separate report-only long-entry-quality diagnosis; do not infer strategy failure from one forward loss.

fixed_target_forward_path.interpretation: These are path counterfactuals, not orders or executable after-cost fills. The 40-bps touch motivated the already-preregistered development comparison but cannot authorize a live exit change.

development_exit_comparison.scope: long-only development, nine trades, validation and holdout withheld

diagnosis.most_supported_interpretation: One technically correct long entered a large gap-down reversal, reached a modest favorable excursion, then fully reversed into its planned stop. This is consistent with the historically fragile long slice but is insufficient to distinguish normal variance from a weak long-entry condition.
diagnosis.sample_size_warning: One exact forward long and nine development longs do not establish a stable live expectancy estimate.

recommendation: Keep V56 live unchanged while diagnosing long-entry quality rather than installing a fixed target that failed the preregistered historical comparison.
why_now: The first V56 lifecycle has resolved and provides exact entry, protection, excursion, cost, and exit evidence.
evidence_reviewed: Immutable V56 live audit prefix, exact development baseline, preregistered 40/60/80-bps challenger report, and the prospective decision journal.
observed_problem_or_opportunity: The long captured 50.25 bps gross MFE but surrendered 134.34 bps peak-to-exit; however, generic tight fixed targets destroyed the development long economics by truncating rare large recoveries.
applicable_market_regime: Large U.S. cash-open gap-down reversal in SPCX; canonical crypto regime telemetry is unavailable and not substituted.
alternatives_considered: Close post hoc, tighten the stop, add 40/60/80-bps targets, preserve the route, remove longs, or diagnose entry context. Tight fixed targets are rejected; removing longs from one loss is unsupported; entry-context diagnosis is the next reversible experiment.
expected_upside: Avoid a harmful exit change while identifying whether gap magnitude, reversal strength, or opening liquidity separates recoverable from failed long gaps.
main_risks_and_failure_modes: The next diagnosis can overfit nine trades, unresolved mark slices can bias outcomes, and this single live loss can attract post-hoc explanations.
validation_completed: Exact run/profile identity, entry and five stop fills, fees, funding, slippage, target cancellation, flat/order-free state, MFE/MAE/giveback, fixed-target development family, three folds, leave-largest sensitivity, and sealed OOS were reconciled.
validation_still_required: Causal long-entry feature attribution on every development long, explicit technical-path exclusions, a predeclared compact entry challenger, and at least one further independent forward long lifecycle.
success_metrics: Any entry challenger must improve stress fold stability and leave-largest net over the unchanged long control, preserve exact execution feasibility, and later resolve positively under an independent preregistered forward window.
failure_rollback_triggers: Reject an entry challenger if it relies on unresolved paths, changes entry identities without explicit accounting, loses after costs or largest-winner removal, fails fold stability, or degrades an independent forward lifecycle. No rollback is needed now because no live change is proposed.
confidence_level: High confidence in lifecycle mechanics and fixed-target rejection; low confidence in long-route expectancy because the exact forward sample is one.
confidence_falsifier: Update the diagnosis if additional exact V56 longs show repeatable positive after-cost results, if a technically resolved compact entry challenger is fold-stable and forward-positive, or if later audit evidence contradicts the current fill/cost/excursion reconciliation.
single_highest_value_next_investigation: Development-only causal attribution of SPCX long outcomes by preregistered gap magnitude, opening-bar reversal strength, and opening liquidity, followed by one compact challenger and independent forward collection.

evidence.role: fixed candidate and selection declaration before replay
prospective decision and initial protection evidence
